card.name: The end of hydrochloride in drug names
card.fires_on: The final piece "ide" of "Hydrochloride" right after "Hydrochlor" in a drug name such as bupivacaine or metformin. It also fires weakly on "chlor" inside "Hydrochloride" and on "Injection" after a drug-name salt.
